candidates.term: The Virtuoso inside the Hour Gate
candidates.defline: Brilliance lives inside your Hour Gate: the root of your harvest is a mind that never retires.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family and Mind at the root of late life. Your old age keeps its claws and its wit: the elder who says the unsayable at dinner and is usually right. Children and students sharpen against you, which is a gift when it teaches and a wound when it cuts. Save the sharpest tongue for injustice. The people you love will remember your last decade’s words verbatim. Author them.
